parts.label: Skull (cranium and face)
parts.info: Protects the brain and supports the face; the cranial bones are fused at sutures.

parts.label: Mandible
parts.info: The lower jaw, the only movable bone of the skull.

parts.label: Vertebral column
parts.info: Stack of vertebrae and discs that supports the body and protects the spinal cord.

parts.label: Ribs and costal cartilages
parts.info: Twelve pairs that form the thoracic cage and move during breathing.

parts.label: Sternum
parts.info: The breastbone, joined to the ribs by costal cartilage.

parts.label: Clavicle and scapula
parts.info: The shoulder girdle that attaches the arm to the trunk.

parts.label: Radius and ulna
parts.info: The two forearm bones; the radius rotates around the ulna.

parts.label: Hand (carpals, metacarpals, phalanges)
parts.info: Twenty-seven bones that give the hand its fine movement.

parts.label: Hip bones (pelvis)
parts.info: Each hip bone is a fused ilium, ischium and pubis; together they bear the body's weight.

parts.label: Femur
parts.info: The thigh bone, the longest and strongest bone in the body.

parts.label: Patella
parts.info: The kneecap, a sesamoid bone in the quadriceps tendon.

parts.label: Tibia and fibula
parts.info: The shin bone (tibia) carries the weight; the fibula anchors muscles.

parts.label: Foot (tarsals, metatarsals, phalanges)
parts.info: Twenty-six bones forming the arches of the foot.

parts.label: Other bones and ligaments
parts.info: Smaller skeletal parts such as the hyoid and ligaments.
